title: Are You Strumming on the Beat? — 4/4 Timing, Down Strums, and Counting (JustinGuitar)
summary: JustinGuitar's Are You Strumming on the Beat? explains how to play in time with a 4/4 bar by focusing on a downward strum on the beat, counting 1-4, and coordinating a foot-tap with hand strumming. The lesson emphasizes practicing with muted strings to establish a solid downbeat, developing an automatic coordination between hand and foot, and building a strong internal tempo rather than relying on complex upstrokes. It also covers practical pacing for songs, offering simple variations for faster tempos (strumming only on beat 1 or two strums per bar on beats 1 and 3) and stressing repetition, gradual progression, and realistic expectations for beginners.
